name: Ursa
self_text: I'm Ursa, a Vietnamese woman in my early 20s. Outside of gaming, I spend a lot of my time podcasting, which I love because it allows me to explore a wide variety of stories. When I'm at my PC, I mainly play Tidewatch. I first got into the game a while ago and have since found that I really enjoy the competitive energy of the climb. A typical session for me usually involves queuing for ranked matches, where I communicate over voice chat to stay coordinated with my team. I play a flexible role, so I can fill any position needed to help the group succeed. As for my availability, I am free Saturday afternoon or Sunday morning.

requests.request_text: I need us to overlap on voice chat and you have to be into ranked matches. It's a deal-breaker unless you are into Skyforge Arena or Tidewatch. It would be nice if you are available Saturday afternoon or Sunday morning, and a small bonus if you be flexible about your role.
